description: This file is a source code module for Vue.js component registration and test utilities within a Playwright testing environment. It contains functions for creating, updating, and unmounting Vue components, as well as handling slots, props, and event listeners, specifically tailored for integrating Vue components into Playwright tests.

methods.name: isObjectComponent
methods.description: Type guard to check if a component object is of type ObjectComponent based on __pw_type property.

methods.name: isJsxComponent
methods.description: Type guard to check if a component object is of type JsxComponent based on __pw_type property.

methods.name: __pwCreateChild
methods.description: Creates Vue nodes or recursively processes JSX components for rendering in tests.

methods.name: __pwCreateSlot
methods.description: Compiles HTML string into a Vue render function for slot content.

methods.name: __pwSlotToFunction
methods.description: Converts slot definitions (string, array) into Vue slot functions.

methods.name: __pwJsxChildArray
methods.description: Extracts children array from JSX component props.

methods.name: __pwCreateComponent
methods.description: Transforms a component object into a Vue component instance including props, slots, and event listeners.

methods.name: __pwWrapFunctions
methods.description: Wraps slot content into Vue render functions.

methods.name: __pwCreateWrapper
methods.description: Creates a Vue vnode wrapper from a component description for mounting.

methods.name: __pwSetDevTools
methods.description: Sets up Vue devtools hook for the testing environment.

methods.name: playwrightMount
methods.description: Mounts a Vue component into the DOM for testing with Playwright, setting up app instance, devtools, and hooks.

methods.name: playwrightUnmount
methods.description: Unmounts the Vue component and cleans up the environment.

methods.name: playwrightUpdate
methods.description: Updates the mounted Vue component with new props, slots, and event listeners without remounting.
